name: xenixc
title: the C compiler of XENIX for the 8086 (cpp, c0, c1, c2, as), Altos ACS 8600 XENIX 2.3, 1983
_kit: the XENIX files (lib/cpp, lib/c0, lib/c1, lib/c2, bin/as): binaries/altos-8600-xenix/files/c23
_variants: altos: the diskette's passes as they are; microsoft: the revision Microsoft built LINK 2.40/2.44 and LIB 2.20/2.40 with (exact/xenix_c.py says what differs)

carve._prologues: push bp / mov bp,sp, then (most functions) push di / push si: XENIX C saves both register variables (135 of LIB 2.20's 233 places)
